# peakhour_rate_limit_zone (Resource)

Manages a rate limit zone. Zones define rate limiting rules that can be referenced in rules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "peakhour_rate_limit_zone" "example" {
  domain                = "example.com"
  name                  = "api"
  requests_max          = 100
  requests_interval_sec = 60
  block_duration_sec    = 300
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain name.
- `name` (String) Zone name (used to reference in rules).

### Optional

- `block_duration_sec` (Number) How long to block when limit exceeded (seconds).
- `connections_interval_sec` (Number) Time window for connection limit (seconds).
- `connections_max` (Number) Maximum connections in interval.
- `requests_interval_sec` (Number) Time window for request limit (seconds).
- `requests_max` (Number) Maximum requests in interval.
- `response_errors_interval_sec` (Number) Time window for response error limit (seconds).
- `response_errors_max` (Number) Maximum response errors in interval.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Zone identifier (domain/name).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import peakhour_rate_limit_zone.example example.com/api
```
